items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: George Morris, his trombone, trombone. ... And, myself, about a six piece band.

ctx.x: Who was in that band with you, in the match band?

George Morris, his trombone, trombone. And Sawyer, Sawyer, Sawyer, he was a drummer. And, let's see, I can't call this boy the Badger player. It's kind of like Wilbur or something, Wilbur or something like that, the way his name was. But he lives in Mobile, but he stayed over in Pensacola. And, myself, about a six piece band. Six piece band, I would have about six pieces. A clarinet player? Well we had saxophone play, had Leach out of Chicago. Leach, that's right. Leach out of Chicago, a boy played sax.
Where was George Morris from? Mobile.

items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And also the trombone, he was out of Mobile with George, uh, George Morris. He was out of Mobile. Well, I worked with them.

ctx.x: Been here. Long time. Another thing, I don't like to worry a lot about those old times. I like to hear about it.

I would make it to you. And then, uh, that's the band I played with in Birmingham. All right. I lived in Birmingham. I went down in Florida. I went home, you see. Then, I joined the band of Mac Merrimickles Band. See. I worked with them. See, well, most of all the fellas was in Florida, was out of Florida, except Mac. And also the trombone, he was out of Mobile with George, uh, George Morris. He was out of Mobile. Well, I worked with them. Long time. Just traveling around on the road, see. And then after I, uh,…
